description.name: Altbau Loft Kreuzberg
description.headline: Top-floor loft with high ceilings
description.description:
A two-bedroom loft on the fourth floor of an Altbau building. Ceilings are just over three metres and the windows face east, so mornings are bright.

There is no lift. The building has a shared courtyard.

reviews: Lovely flat, but be aware it really is four floors and no lift. We managed with two suitcases.
The ceilings and windows make it feel enormous. Coffee places on the same street.
Heating worked well in November. Courtyard was quiet even on a Saturday night.

policies.cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 7 days before arrival.
